mule.name: Mule-class utility hauler
mule.description: Thirty years old, three previous owners, two refits. The truss is sound and the drive still lights. Everything else is negotiable.

lunar_tanker.name: Cooperative bulk tanker
lunar_tanker.description: Luna Cooperative workhorse: two bulk containers on a Mule truss, run by a crew of three and a very patient AI.

drone_freighter.name: Commons drone freighter
drone_freighter.description: Uncrewed and unhurried. Each one is a mind of The Commons that has chosen, for now, to haul freight.

courier.name: Compact fast courier
courier.description: Small cargo cage, big drive, bigger radiators. Medicine and parts that cannot wait.

shuttle.name: Kernel passenger shuttle
shuttle.description: Settlers, visiting engineers and the occasional tourist, two dozen at a time.
